easy.explain: Rarely đứng đầu câu → đảo ngữ, câu gốc không có trợ động từ nên mượn does: Rarely does he work.
Seldom đầu câu → trợ động từ đứng trước chủ ngữ: Seldom have I tasted.

easy.q: No sooner had we arrived ___ it started to snow.
easy.explain: Cặp cố định: No sooner … than.

easy.q: Hardly had the film started ___ the lights went out.
___ I you, I would apologise to her.
easy.explain: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2 với be → Were I you = If I were you.

easy.q: Under no circumstances ___ open this door.
easy.explain: Under no circumstances đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ: should you open.

easy.q: ___ I known about the problem, I would have helped.
easy.explain: Điều kiện loại 3 đảo ngữ: Had + S + V3 = If I had known.

easy.q: Little ___ that his life was about to change.
easy.explain: Little đầu câu → đảo, mượn did + V nguyên mẫu: Little did he know.

easy.q: I don't eat seafood. – Neither ___ I.
easy.explain: Câu trước dùng 'don't eat' (hiện tại đơn) → Neither do I.

easy.q: Not only ___ beautiful, but she is also very kind.
easy.explain: Not only đầu câu → đảo be lên trước chủ ngữ: is she.

normal.q: Not until I got home ___ that my keys were missing.
normal.explain: Not until + mệnh đề: chỉ mệnh đề chính đảo → did I realise. 'I realised' giữ trật tự thường nên sai.

normal.q: Only after the meeting ___ the new plan to us.
normal.explain: Only after + cụm từ đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ: did the manager explain. Không đảo động từ chính như 'explained the manager'.

normal.q: No sooner ___ the phone than it rang again.
normal.explain: No sooner + had + S + V3 + than. 'I had put down' quên đảo trợ động từ.

options.A: Only does John know the answer.
options.C: Never I have seen such a mess.
options.D: Rarely he goes out at night.

normal.explain: Only đi với chủ ngữ thì không đảo → Only John knows. Hai câu Never/Rarely thiếu đảo ngữ.

normal.q: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot his laptop.
normal.explain: Not only đầu câu + động từ thường ở quá khứ → mượn did: did he arrive.

normal.q: ___ it rain tomorrow, the match will be postponed.
normal.explain: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1: Should + S + V = If it rains. 'Had/Did' sai vì theo sau là V nguyên mẫu và mệnh đề chính dùng 'will'.

normal.q: Scarcely ___ the house when it began to pour.
normal.explain: Scarcely + had + S + V3 + when. 'we had left' không đảo nên sai.

normal.q: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Rarely (B) we have seen (C) such a talented (D) young player.
normal.explain: Rarely đầu câu phải đảo → have we seen.

normal.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'If he had listened to my advice, he wouldn't have lost his money.'

options.A: Had he listen to my advice, he wouldn't have lost his money.
options.B: Had he listened to my advice, he wouldn't have lost his money.
options.C: Did he listen to my advice, he wouldn't have lost his money.
options.D: If had he listened to my advice, he wouldn't have lost his money.

normal.explain: Điều kiện loại 3 đảo ngữ: bỏ if, Had + S + V3. Không giữ 'if' khi đã đảo, và không dùng 'Did'.

normal.q: She has already finished the course. – So ___ I.
normal.explain: Câu trước dùng 'has finished' (trợ động từ have) → So have I. 'So do I' sai vì không khớp trợ động từ.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: No sooner (A) had the guests (B) arrived (C) when the (D) power went out.
hard.explain: No sooner đi với than, không đi với when → 'than the power went out'. 'when' chỉ dùng với Hardly/Scarcely.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'I only realised how important my family was when I moved abroad.'

options.A: Only when did I move abroad I realised how important my family was.
options.B: Only when I moved abroad I realised how important my family was.
options.C: Not until did I move abroad I realised how important my family was.
options.D: Only when I moved abroad did I realise how important my family was.

hard.explain: Only when + mệnh đề: mệnh đề phụ giữ nguyên, chỉ mệnh đề chính đảo → did I realise. Đảo ở mệnh đề phụ là sai.

options.A: Hadn't I seen it myself, I wouldn't have believed it.
options.B: Had I not seen it myself, I wouldn't have believed it.
options.C: Were she to find out, she would be furious.
options.D: Should you change your mind, let me know.

hard.explain: Đảo ngữ điều kiện không viết tắt phủ định → phải là 'Had I not seen'. Các câu còn lại là đảo ngữ đúng.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'As soon as she sat down, the phone rang.'

options.A: Hardly had she sat down than the phone rang.
options.B: Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang.
options.C: No sooner she had sat down than the phone rang.
options.D: Hardly did she sat down when the phone rang.

hard.explain: Hardly + had + S + V3 + when. Hardly không đi với than; 'No sooner she had' quên đảo; 'did she sat' sai dạng V.

hard.q: So difficult ___ that only a few students passed.
hard.explain: So + adj + be + S + that → So difficult was the exam. Tính từ đi với be, không mượn did.

hard.q: At no time ___ that the company was in financial trouble.
hard.explain: At no time đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ 'were' lên trước chủ ngữ: were the employees told. 'did … told' sai vì sau did phải là V nguyên mẫu.

hard.q: Only by saving regularly ___ enough money for a house.
hard.explain: Only by + V-ing đầu câu → đảo ở mệnh đề chính: can you collect.

hard.q: Tìm lỗi sai: Little (A) did she (B) knew (C) that her friends (D) were planning a surprise party.
hard.explain: Sau did phải dùng V nguyên mẫu → did she know. Đảo 'did she' là đúng.

hard.q: Chọn câu gần nghĩa nhất với: 'If you should see Mai, please give her this letter.'

options.A: Should you saw Mai, please give her this letter.
options.B: Should you see Mai, please give her this letter.
options.C: Were you see Mai, please give her this letter.
options.D: Had you see Mai, please give her this letter.

hard.explain: If you should + V → Should you + V nguyên mẫu. Were/Had không đi với V nguyên mẫu 'see'.

hard.q: Câu nào dưới đây ĐÚNG ngữ pháp?

options.A: Not only she won the race, but she also broke the record.
options.B: Not only did she won the race, but she also broke the record.
options.C: Not only did she win the race, but she also broke the record.
options.D: Not only won she the race, but she also broke the record.

hard.explain: Not only + did + S + V nguyên mẫu → did she win. Các phương án khác quên đảo, sai dạng V sau did, hoặc đảo động từ chính.
